_provenance.source: uv lock --check run over the release PR head files of OmniNode-ai/omnimarket#3888 and over the uv.lock that uv wrote for the same version on omnimarket dev
_provenance.command: uv lock --check, in a directory holding the release head pyproject.toml with (a) the release head uv.lock and (b) the uv.lock at the dev commit; the root package block is the [[package]] block named omnimarket from each lock
_provenance.note: the dev commit uv.lock was written by uv, not by hand; the release head uv.lock is the one the train left at 0.4.313 beside a pyproject.toml bumped to 0.4.314; release_head_pyproject_project_table is the first three lines of the release head [project] table (table header, name, version), cut so the recording carries no unrelated project metadata
